records.text: An anonymous tipster told Owens that a Caldera Engineering employee had a professional acting and theater background but no engineering background.
records.speaker: Caldera actor tipster (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Then I also decided to prod the narrative further. Another person gave us a tip and said, "Hey, did you know that there's literally someone who works at Caldera Engineering who is a professional actor?" No background engineering, went to school for theater, worked in theater, was in plays, was involved in plays.

verification.notes: The tipster and employee are unnamed, so the claimed resume, education, acting work, and absence of engineering experience cannot be matched to a specific person. Caldera's public site does not identify enough employee history to test the anonymous allegation.
